prompt.generated_prompt_string: Using the attached adult subject reference as mandatory identity source, create a vertical 9:16 above-waist beach portrait after sunset. Preserve the person's exact identity, face, age presentation, skin tone, hair, and recognizable features. Frame them from behind as they turn toward the camera, with windswept hair, a loose light-yellow half-open linen shirt with rolled sleeves, and a subtle gold seashell necklace. Use direct on-camera flash to give the face a sun-kissed, softly luminous look with restrained glitter sheen. In the background, show a nearly dark beach and ocean beneath a deep purple-red sky after the sun has almost set. Keep the result candid, natural, and identity-preserving. No text, logo, watermark, or sexualized styling.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, identity change, face swap, age alteration, public figure, celebrity likeness, minor, child, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, text, logo, watermark

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: An authorized adult non-public-figure subject reference is mandatory. Preserve identity exactly; only change wardrobe, beach setting, crop, pose direction, and lighting as described. Do not generate a different person or infer identity details that are absent from the reference.
